records.jp: お前っていつもビクビクしてるよな！
records.en_original: Hey! Why're you always so jumpy?
records.en: Hey! Why're you always so jumpy?

records.jp: そ、そう、かな……
records.en_original: O-oh, am I...?
records.en: O-oh, am I...?

records.jp: だははははは！！　ビビッてやんの！
records.en_original: Bahahahahaha! Your face!
records.en: Bahahahahaha! Your face!

records.jp: 毎日、わたしと一緒でいいの……？
records.en_original: Y-you don't mind walking with me every day?
records.en: Y-you don't mind walking with me every day?

records.jp: ？　どういう意味ですか？
records.en_original: Hm? What do you mean?
records.en: Hm? What do you mean?

records.jp: あいつら、コソコソ何かしてると思ったら、^00秘密基地なんて作ってたらしいぜ？
records.en_original: I thought those two were up to something. They were secretly making a secret hideout!
records.en: I thought those two were up to something. They were secretly making a secret hideout!

records.jp: なあおい、壊しに行こうぜ！
records.en_original: Let's go and destroy it!
records.en: Let's go and destroy it!

records.jp: ああ、俺たちに黙って秘密基地なんて作ったら^00こうなるんだって教えてやる！
records.en_original: Yeah, we have to teach 'em a lesson! This is what happens when you keep secrets from us!
records.en: Yeah, we have to teach 'em a lesson! This is what happens when you keep secrets from us!

records.jp: 無理だよ……。逆らったら、^00またいじめられるだけだから……
records.en_original: I can't... Even if I did, they'd just bully me even more...
records.en: I can't... Even if I did, they'd just bully me even more...

records.jp: そうやって怖がって、逃げて、^00何もしないから、何も変わらないんです！
records.en_original: If you just get scared and run away,^00they'll take advantage of that!
records.en: If you just get scared and run away,^00they'll take advantage of that!

records.jp: こいつは弱いし、やりかえさないから、^00いじめてもいいんだって！
records.en_original: They think they can bully you because you're weak and won't do anything about it!
records.en: They think they can bully you because you're weak and won't do anything about it!

records.jp: 私……――ちゃんみたいに、強くないもん
records.en_original: I'm not strong like you, ――.
records.en: I'm not strong like you, ――.

records.jp: なんで……なんでそうやって、^00自分を傷つけることばかり言うんですか？
records.en_original: Why... Why do you always say such horrible things about yourself?
records.en: Why... Why do you always say such horrible things about yourself?

records.jp: 嫌です、私……こころがそうやって泣いてるの、^00もう見たくないです
records.en_original: I hate it... I don't want to see you crying like that any more.
records.en: I hate it... I don't want to see you crying like that any more.

records.jp: ねえねえ、あの子の話聞いた？
records.en_original: Did you hear about that one girl?
records.en: Did you hear about that one girl?

records.jp: なんでも、クラスメートの男の子を殴ったとか
records.en_original: Always hitting the boys in her class and whatnot?
records.en: Always hitting the boys in her class and whatnot?

records.jp: 怖いわねぇ。まあでも、よかったんじゃない？^00――ちゃん、転校するんでしょ？
records.en_original: What a terror. I guess it's for the best that ――'s transferring schools.
records.en: What a terror. I guess it's for the best that ――'s transferring schools.

records.jp: 他人のことばかりで、^00自分のことなんて全然考えてない
records.en_original: You're too nice to other people. You never think about yourself.
records.en: You're too nice to other people. You never think about yourself.

records.jp: わ、分かんないよ。――ちゃん……
records.en_original: I-I don't get it, ――...
records.en: I-I don't get it, ――...

records.jp: 誰にも迷惑かけないようにって、^00助けてって言わないから……
records.en_original: You always try so hard not to bother other people^00and keep it all bottled up inside...
records.en: You always try so hard not to bother other people^00and keep it all bottled up inside...

records.jp: わたし、嫌われたくなかった
records.en_original: I didn't want you to hate me.
records.en: I didn't want you to hate me.

records.jp: わたしのこと、信じてくれてなかったんですね
records.en_original: So you didn't trust me.
records.en: So you didn't trust me.

records.jp: でも、そんなこころだから、^00わたしは友達でいたいんです
records.en_original: But that's exactly the Kokoro I want to be friends with.
records.en: But that's exactly the Kokoro I want to be friends with.

records.jp: ごめんなさい。明日も家の手伝いなんです
records.en_original: I'm sorry. I have to help out tomorrow too.
records.en: I'm sorry. I have to help out tomorrow too.

records.jp: ううん、好きだから平気ですよ
records.en_original: No, no. I actually like it, so it's fine.
records.en: No, no. I actually like it, so it's fine.

records.jp: 習い事もやめちゃったんでしょ？^00たしか、バレエだっけ？
records.en_original: Weren't you taking ballet lessons before? Did you quit those too?
records.en: Weren't you taking ballet lessons before? Did you quit those too?

records.jp: うわー、よくできた娘さんだ
records.en_original: My, young lady, look how mature you are!
records.en: My, young lady, look how mature you are!

records.jp: バレエ、好きじゃなかった？
records.en_original: Did you not like ballet?
records.en: Did you not like ballet?

records.jp: 毎日、同じことの繰り返しで。^00本当にこのままでいいのかなって思うときはあります
records.en_original: Every day is the same thing over and over again. I do wonder sometimes if this is truly what I want.
records.en: Every day is the same thing over and over again. I do wonder sometimes if this is truly what I want.

records.jp: 実はさ、私もバレエしてるんだよね
records.en_original: Actually, I used to do ballet too.
records.en: Actually, I used to do ballet too.

records.jp: ありがとうございます。また来てください
records.en_original: Thank you very much. Please come again!
records.en: Thank you very much. Please come again!

records.jp: ……じゃあ、ここにいるのは一時だけなんですね。^00ちょっと残念です
records.en_original: ...So you will only be here this once. That is a shame.
records.en: ...So you will only be here this once. That is a shame.

records.jp: うん。でもバレエのことなら、^00全然気にならないんだよね
records.en_original: As long as it's for ballet, though, I don't mind at all.
records.en: As long as it's for ballet, though, I don't mind at all.

records.jp: 好きでお店の手伝いをしてるはずなのに、^00あなたみたいに上手く笑えなくて
records.en_original: I'm supposedly working at the shop because I like it, and yet... I can't smile like you do.
records.en: I'm supposedly working at the shop because I like it, and yet... I can't smile like you do.

records.jp: ……ありがとうございます
records.en_original: ...Thank you very much.
records.en: ...Thank you very much.

records.jp: 転校？
records.en_original: You transferred?
records.en: You transferred?

records.jp: だからわたしは、毎日喫茶店を手伝ってるんです
records.en_original: That is why I help out at the cafe every day.
records.en: That is why I help out at the cafe every day.

records.jp: まるで、罪を償う囚人みたいに
records.en_original: It's like I am a prisoner, atoning for my sins.
records.en: It's like I am a prisoner, atoning for my sins.

records.jp: さ、詩帆！　遊びに行こ！
records.en_original: All right, Shiho. We're going out!
records.en: All right, Shiho. We're going out!

records.jp: あ、遊びにって、どこへ……？
records.en_original: G-going out? To where...?
records.en: G-going out? To where...?

records.jp: ほ、本当にバレエ一筋なんですね……
records.en_original: Wow, you must really be into ballet, huh?
records.en: Wow, you must really be into ballet, huh?

records.jp: なんだか、冒険みたいだなって
records.en_original: This is like some kind of adventure.
records.en: This is like some kind of adventure.

records.jp: 冒険？
records.en_original: Adventure?
records.en: Adventure?

records.jp: 冒険、か……。^00そう言われると、なんだかワクワクしますね
records.en_original: An adventure... Now that you put it that way, this feels quite exciting.
records.en: An adventure... Now that you put it that way, this feels quite exciting.

records.jp: きっと私たちも、レールの上の電車と同じだよね
records.en_original: We're just like trains on a set of tracks, aren't we?
records.en: We're just like trains on a set of tracks, aren't we?

records.jp: どういう意味、ですか？
records.en_original: What do you mean by that?
records.en: What do you mean by that?

records.jp: 私たちは、大きく道を外れることはできない
records.en_original: We can't really get away from the tracks we're on.
records.en: We can't really get away from the tracks we're on.

records.jp: ゴールも分からないままね
records.en_original: Without even knowing what the goal is...
records.en: Without even knowing what the goal is...

records.jp: ええ。バレエをしてる時の日菜子は、^00家でも見せないような笑顔で……
records.en_original: Yes, Hinako is never as happy as she is when she's dancing.
records.en: Yes, Hinako is never as happy as she is when she's dancing.

records.jp: いえ、すごいのは日菜子ちゃんですから
records.en_original: Don't thank me! Hinako is the one with the talent here.
records.en: Don't thank me! Hinako-chan is the one with the talent here.

records.jp: あの子、すごい集中力なんですよ
records.en_original: That girl has so much focus. It's amazing.
records.en: That girl has so much focus. It's amazing.

records.jp: 言葉が悪くて申し訳ないのですが……^00ちょっと恐ろしいくらいです
records.en_original: I apologize for my choice of words, but... It's almost frightening.
records.en: I apologize for my choice of words, but... It's almost frightening.

records.jp: 日菜子に、そんな才能が……
records.en_original: Hinako really has that much talent...?
records.en: Hinako really has that much talent...?

records.jp: 先生、ずっと日菜子さんにつきっきりだね……
records.en_original: The teacher's always so focused on Hinako...
records.en: The teacher's always so focused on Hinako-san...

records.jp: ……ムカつく
records.en_original: ...So annoying.
records.en: ...So annoying.

records.jp: あなたたち、悔しくないの？
records.en_original: Aren't you guys frustrated with yourselves?
records.en: Aren't you guys frustrated with yourselves?

records.jp: 近々制服も届くと思うから、その時は着てみてね
records.en_original: Your uniform will get here sometime soon, so try it on when it arrives.
records.en: Your uniform will get here sometime soon, so try it on when it arrives.

records.jp: 今日は冷えるから、ちゃんと暖かくして寝るのよ
records.en_original: Make sure you sleep under the covers tonight. It's going to get chilly.
records.en: Make sure you sleep under the covers tonight. It's going to get chilly.

records.jp: うん
records.en_original: 'Kay.
records.en: 'Kay.

records.jp: 今度彼氏とデートなんだよねー
records.en_original: He's taking me out on a date next time!
records.en: He's taking me out on a date next time!

records.jp: のろけは聞きたくないんだけど？
records.en_original: Hey, I don't wanna hear all about your love life.
records.en: Hey, I don't wanna hear all about your love life.

records.jp: （私は、どこに行くのかな――）
records.en_original: (Where am I even going...?)
records.en: (Where am I even going...?)

records.jp: 私、お腹すいた！
records.en_original: I'm getting hungry!
records.en: I'm getting hungry!

records.jp: じゃ、なんか食べに行こ
records.en_original: Okay, let's go get some food!
records.en: Okay, let's go get some food!

records.jp: そうだ、私雰囲気よさげなお店見つけたんだよね――
records.en_original: Ohhh, I found this restaurant that looks really nice...
records.en: Ohhh, I found this restaurant that looks really nice...

records.jp: ……カラオケ
records.en_original: ...Karaoke.
records.en: ...Karaoke.

records.jp: な、何歌えばいいの？
records.en_original: Wh-what should I sing?
records.en: Wh-what should I sing?

records.jp: そんなの、私に聞かれても……
records.en_original: I don't think I can tell you that...
records.en: I don't think I can tell you that...

records.jp: ほら、スマホ出して
records.en_original: Come on, take out your phone.
records.en: Come on, take out your phone.

records.jp: ユズ、クレーンゲームやったことあるの？
records.en_original: Have you played a claw machine before?
records.en: Have you played a claw machine before?

records.jp: 天性の才能、でしょうね……
records.en_original: I guess I'm just naturally skilled...
records.en: I guess I'm just naturally skilled...

records.jp: ほんと不思議だわ、ユズの謎才能
records.en_original: Something's definitely off about your mysterious skills...
records.en: Something's definitely off about your mysterious skills...

records.jp: ヒナちゃん、ほっぺたにクリームついてるよ！
records.en_original: You got some cream on your cheek!
records.en: Hina-chan, you've got cream on your cheek!

records.jp: そんなにクレープ美味しかったの～？
records.en_original: Was the crepe was THAT good?
records.en: Was the crepe was THAT good?

records.jp: あ、ちょ、逃げるな！
records.en_original: Hey, get back here!
records.en: Hey, get back here!

records.jp: ここってサーフィンとかできないのかな？
records.en_original: Can you go surfing and stuff here?
records.en: Can you go surfing and stuff here?

records.jp: ん？　できないよ！^00できたら面白いなーって思っただけ！
records.en_original: Huh? No way! I just thought it be cool if people surfed here.
records.en: Huh? No way! I just thought it be cool if people surfed here.

records.jp: めっちゃよかったじゃん！！
records.en_original: That's great!!
records.en: That's great!!

records.jp: なんで断っちゃったの！？
records.en_original: Why did you turn him down?!
records.en: Why did you turn him down?!

records.jp: え？　何する気……？
records.en_original: Huh? What are you...?
records.en: Huh? What are you...?

records.jp: ……ああ、もう！
records.en_original: ...Ugh, fine!
records.en: ...Ugh, fine!

records.jp: あははっ！！　めっちゃいい感じ！
records.en_original: Ahahah! That was great!
records.en: Ahahah! That was great!

records.jp: 私、星が好き
records.en_original: I like looking at the stars.
records.en: I like looking at the stars.

records.jp: お、おかしいかな
records.en_original: Y-yeah, I know it's weird.
records.en: Y-yeah, I know it's weird.

records.jp: 意外とロマンチストなとこあんだね
records.en_original: I didn't expect you to be such a romantic.
records.en: I didn't expect you to be such a romantic.

records.jp: あんた、本心は絶対に明かさないじゃん
records.en_original: You never show your true feelings.
records.en: You never show your true feelings.

records.jp: えっ！？　口だけ女ってこと！？
records.en_original: What? Are you saying^00I'm two-faced?!
records.en: What? Are you saying^00I'm two-faced?!

records.jp: むむむ……そうなのか……
records.en_original: Hrmm... You think...?
records.en: Hrmm... You think...?

records.jp: 勇希、今度さ。星、見に行こうよ
records.en_original: Yuki, let's go see the stars sometime.
records.en: Yuki, let's go see the stars sometime.

records.jp: 約束ね
records.en_original: All right, then.^00You better keep your promise.
records.en: All right, then.^00You better keep your promise.

records.jp: お～こわ。分かった分かった
records.en_original: Scary... Okay, I'll be there!
records.en: Scary... Okay, I'll be there!

records.jp: あ、あの！　すみません。勇希……えっと、^00この近くに金城さんの家って――
records.en_original: E-excuse me! Do you know where Yuki's...I mean, the Kinjous' house is—
records.en: E-excuse me! Do you know where Kinjou-san's...I mean, the Kinjous' house is—

records.jp: 勇希……
records.en_original: Yuki...
records.en: Yuki...

records.jp: どうして、何も言わずにどっか行っちゃったの……？
records.en_original: Why did you disappear ^00without even saying goodbye...?
records.en: Why did you disappear ^00without even saying goodbye...?

records.jp: 私、勇希が分かんないよ……
records.en_original: I don't understand you, Yuki...
records.en: I don't understand you, Yuki...

records.jp: 勇希がいないと、私……
records.en_original: Without you, I...
records.en: Without you, I...

records.jp: そう、ですか……
records.en_original: Oh. Okay...
records.en: Oh. Okay...

records.jp: あ、すみません。少しお伺いしたいのですが……――
records.en_original: Oh, excuse me. Could I ask you something?
records.en: Oh, excuse me. Could I ask you something?

records.jp: 金城？　ああ、知ってるわよ。うち、近所だから
records.en_original: The Kinjous? Yes, I know them. They were my neighbors.
records.en: The Kinjous? Yes, I know them. They were my neighbors.

records.jp: げっ、おばけ女！
records.en_original: Eww, it's the ghost girl!
records.en: Eww, it's the ghost girl!

records.jp: なんだよ、何か用かよ！
records.en_original: What do you want?
records.en: What do you want?

records.jp: きらら、どこに行ってたんだ？　探したぞ
records.en_original: Kirara, where were you?^00We were looking all over for you.
records.en: Kirara, where were you?^00We were looking all over for you.

records.jp: ごめんなさい、“声”が聞こえて……
records.en_original: I'm sorry, I heard the voice...
records.en: I'm sorry, I heard the voice...

records.jp: もういい加減、パパを困らせるのはやめてくれ
records.en_original: Cut it out already. You're gonna drive me crazy.
records.en: Please stop troubling Papa already.

records.jp: あなたも、行く場所がないの？
records.en_original: You got nowhere to go either?
records.en: You got nowhere to go either?

records.jp: きららも、ついてくるなって言われた。怖いって
records.en_original: Everyone always tells me to go away.^00They're scared of me...
records.en: Everyone always tells me to go away.^00They're scared of me...

records.jp: そ、そんな。ひどい……
records.en_original: That's so mean...
records.en: That's so mean...

records.jp: ねえ、聞いた？　久野さんの家の……
records.en_original: Hey, did you hear about the Kunos?
records.en: Hey, did you hear about Kuno-san's family...?

records.jp: へえ……。なんだかドラマみたいな話ね
records.en_original: Really...? It's like something out of a movie.
records.en: Really...? It's like something out of a movie.

records.jp: 村のお偉方は「神の使いだ！」って^00大喜びしてるみたいだけどね……
records.en_original: The village heads were real excited about it,^00though. Calling her a "divine messenger"...
records.en: The village heads were real excited about it,^00though. Calling her a "divine messenger"...

records.jp: 神、かどうかは分からないけど……
records.en_original: I don't know if it's really the Divine, but...
records.en: I don't know if it's really the Divine, but...

records.jp: は、はは……ははは！　神の子だ！^00きららは……神の子だったんだ！
records.en_original: Haha... HAHAHAHA! Kirara, you are a child of the Divine!
records.en: Haha... HAHAHAHA! Kirara, you are a child of the Divine!

records.jp: パパが間違ってた！　ごめんな、きらら！
records.en_original: I was wrong about you! Sorry, Kirara!
records.en: Papa was wrong! I'm sorry, Kirara!

records.jp: きららさんのおかげで、被害も出ずに済みました！
records.en_original: Thanks to you, Kirara, we were able to get rid of them without any injuries!
records.en: Thanks to you, Kirara-san, we were able to get rid of them without any injuries!

records.jp: ありがとう、きららさん！
records.en_original: Thank you, Kirara!
records.en: Thank you, Kirara-san!

records.jp: きらら、お前のおかげでパパも鼻が高いぞ！
records.en_original: Kirara, thanks to you, I've earned a lot of respect too!
records.en: Kirara, thanks to you, Papa is proud too!

records.jp: これは、神の力です！^00わが娘、久野きららは神が遣わした救世主なのです！
records.en_original: This is the power of the Divine!^00My daughter, Kirara Kuno, is the Savior sent to us by the Divine!
records.en: This is the power of the Divine!^00My daughter, Kuno Kirara, is the Savior sent to us by the Divine!

records.jp: 未来が見えるのか！？
records.en_original: She can see the future?!
records.en: She can see the future?!

records.jp: 本当に神が遣わした子、なのかもしれんな……
records.en_original: She really has been sent by the Divine...
records.en: She really has been sent by the Divine...

records.jp: どうしたの？
records.en_original: What is it?
records.en: What is it?

records.jp: あいさつまわり、なんだって。^00きららはよく分からないけど
records.en_original: "Making the rounds," he said. I don't really get it.
records.en: "Making the rounds," he said. I don't really get it.

records.jp: き、きっと大切なことなんだよね。^00が、頑張ってね……！
records.en_original: I-I'm sure it's something important. You can do it!
records.en: I-I'm sure it's something important. You can do it!

records.jp: なんだよ、きららは来れないのか？
records.en_original: What? Kirara can't come?
records.en: What? Kirara can't come?

records.jp: だめだよ、怒られるよ！
records.en_original: No, we can't! We'll get in trouble!
records.en: No, we can't! We'll get in trouble!

records.jp: いーんだよ、ほら、行くぞ！
records.en_original: It's fine! Come on, let's go!
records.en: It's fine! Come on, let's go!

records.jp: ツボの伝承……あの祠のツボに何か謂れが……？
records.en_original: The legend of the vase…^00Is there a story behind that vase in the shrine?
records.en: The legend of the vase…^00Is there a story behind that vase in the shrine?

records.jp: 知らんのか！？^00あのツボがあったからこの村は滅びから救われたのじゃ
records.en_original: You mean to say you do not know?!^00It was due to that vase that this village was saved from ruin!
records.en: You mean to say you do not know?!^00It was due to that vase that this village was saved from ruin!

records.jp: どうですか？　調子のほどは
records.en_original: How are things going?
records.en: How are things going?

records.jp: なんとか。^00この調子でいけば、県知事選は勝てるでしょう
records.en_original: Fine, more or less. If things keep going this way, I should be able to win the governor's seat.
records.en: Fine, more or less. If things keep going this way, I should be able to win the governor's seat.

records.jp: 子供をしつけるのも親の責任でしょ？^00ちゃんと言って聞かせておいてください
records.en_original: It's your job to teach your kids manners, isn't it? Keep them under control!
records.en: It's your job to teach your kids manners, isn't it? Keep them under control!

records.jp: はい、すみません……
records.en_original: You're right, I'm sorry...
records.en: You're right, I'm sorry...

records.jp: お母さん……？
records.en_original: Mom...?
records.en: Mom...?

records.jp: お母さん！　お誕生日おめでとう！
records.en_original: Happy birthday, Mom!
records.en: Mom! Happy birthday!

records.jp: 見て、二人でケーキ用意したんだよ
records.en_original: Look, we made you a cake!
records.en: Look, we made you a cake!

records.jp: 陽桜莉……美弦……
records.en_original: Hiori... Mio...
records.en: Hiori... Mio...

records.jp: 平原さん？　さあ、見てないわ
records.en_original: Ms. Hirahara? No, I haven't seen her...
records.en: Hirahara-san? No, I haven't seen her...

records.jp: はあ？　知るわけないでしょ。^00あなたたちもかわいそうね、あんな親で
records.en_original: Uh, no? Why would I?^00I feel bad for you two, having a mother like that...
records.en: Uh, no? Why would I?^00I feel bad for you two, having a mother like that...

records.jp: 大丈夫。大丈夫よ、陽桜莉。^00お姉ちゃんがついてるから……
records.en_original: It's okay, Hiori. Don't worry,^00your big sis is here...
records.en: It's okay, Hiori.^00Onee-chan is here with you...

records.jp: なんで、お母さんは会ってくれないんだろう……
records.en_original: Why doesn't Mom want to see us...?
records.en: Why won't Mom see us...?

records.jp: ……私たち、嫌われちゃったのかな
records.en_original: ...Does she hate us?
records.en: ...Does she hate us?

records.jp: 陽桜莉……
records.en_original: Hiori...
records.en: Hiori...

records.jp: お母さんはあなたたちが憎いのよ
records.en_original: You mother detested you.
records.en: Mom hates you.

records.jp: 女手一つで、二人を養うのは^00さぞ大変だったでしょうね～
records.en_original: It can't have been easy, raising the two of you on her own.
records.en: It can't have been easy, raising the two of you on her own.

records.jp: ……詩。私たち家族の問題に口出ししてこないで
records.en_original: ...Uta. Stay out of our family issues.
records.en: ...Uta. Stay out of our family issues.

records.jp: ……ふふっ。あはは！！
records.en_original: ...Hehe. Ahahaha!
records.en: ...Hehe. Ahahaha!

records.jp: ……やっぱり、狂ってるわ。あなた
records.en_original: ...You really are insane.
records.en: ...You really are insane.

records.jp: あははっ♪　誉め言葉として受け取っておくわ！
records.en_original: Ahahah! I'll take that as a compliment!
records.en: Ahahah! I'll take that as a compliment!

records.jp: はい、検査終わり。お疲れ様、勇希ちゃん
records.en_original: All right, we're all done here. Thank you, Yuki.
records.en: All right, we're all done here. Thank you, Yuki-chan.

records.jp: この調子なら、近いうちに退院できそうね
records.en_original: If you keep this up, I think you'll be out of here soon.
records.en: If you keep this up, I think you'll be out of here soon.

records.jp: なんでもない！　あたし、頑張るね！
records.en_original: Nothing! I'll do my best!
records.en: Nothing! I'll do my best!

records.jp: ねえ、看護師さん。^00看護師さんってどんな学生だったの？
records.en_original: Hey, nurse? What were you like when you were in school?
records.en: Hey, nurse? What were you like when you were in school?

records.jp: 楽しかった？
records.en_original: Was it fun?
records.en: Was it fun?

records.jp: ……あたしは、この先もずっと^00そういうのないまま過ごすのかな
records.en_original: I guess I'll never know...
records.en: I guess I'll never know...

records.jp: ありがとう、勇希お姉ちゃん！^00また絵本読んでね！
records.en_original: Thanks, Yuki! Will you read to me again next time?
records.en: Thank you, Yuki-oneechan!^00Read me another picture book sometime!

records.jp: 強い子ですよね、勇希ちゃんは
records.en_original: She's a tough one, that Yuki.
records.en: She's a tough one, that Yuki-chan.

records.jp: きっと、ああしているのは自分のためだ
records.en_original: It's all she can do to keep herself together.
records.en: It's all she can do to keep herself together.

records.jp: 宮内伶那。あたしの2個上の、先輩
records.en_original: Rena Miyauchi. She was two years older than me.
records.en: Miyauchi Rena. She was two years older than me.

records.jp: どうして、そんなに恵まれているのに^00楽しそうじゃないんだよ
records.en_original: I never understood how she could have so much and still be so miserable.
records.en: I never understood how she could have so much and still be so miserable.

records.jp: あたしは、嘘つきだから
records.en_original: Because I'm a liar.
records.en: Because I'm a liar.

records.jp: 心を縛っていた感情は、苛立ちだった
records.en_original: At first I just felt annoyed.
records.en: At first I just felt annoyed.

records.jp: 「勇希って、何考えてるか全然分かんないんだよね」
records.en_original: I never know what you're thinking, Yuki.
records.en: I never know what you're thinking, Yuki.

records.jp: 「だから、私は……本当の勇希が知りたいの」
records.en_original: I want to know the real you, Yuki.
records.en: I want to know the real you, Yuki.

records.jp: でも、あたしは変わった。^00伶那と出会って、変わってしまった
records.en_original: But I had changed. I had changed, because of Rena.
records.en: But I had changed. I had changed, because of Rena.

records.jp: このまま伶那を置いて去れば、どう思うだろう
records.en_original: I had no idea how Rena would feel if I just left her.
records.en: I had no idea how Rena would feel if I just left her.

records.jp: あたしなんかのせいで、伶那を傷つけたくない。^00だからきっと、これが最善の方法なんだ
records.en_original: I couldn't bear the thought of hurting Rena.^00It would be better this way.
records.en: I couldn't bear the thought of hurting Rena.^00It would be better this way.

records.jp: 詩さん、大丈夫！？^00血が出てる……救急車呼ばないと――！
records.en_original: Uta, Are you okay?!^00You're bleeding! We have to call an ambulance—
records.en: Uta-san, Are you okay?!^00You're bleeding! We have to call an ambulance—

records.jp: あは、あははははははは！！^00これです！　この痛みだけが私を生かしてくれる！
records.en_original: Ha! Ahahaha! This is it! This is the pain I live for!
records.en: Ha! Ahahaha! This is it! This is the pain I live for!

records.jp: 私は痛みが欲しいの！^00人のいない世界なんて意味がないじゃない！
records.en_original: What I want is pain!^00What's the point of a world without people?!
records.en: What I want is pain!^00What's the point of a world without people?!

records.jp: 私はそんなの望んでない！^00返せ！　この世界は私のものだ――！！
records.en_original: I don't want this! Give it back! This world is mine!
records.en: I don't want this! Give it back! This world is mine!

records.jp: 生きてたんだ、私……
records.en_original: I'm...alive.
records.en: I'm...alive.

records.jp: ……ふふ。ふふふ、あはは――！！
records.en_original: Hehehehe... Hahaha!
records.en: Hehehehe... Hahaha!

records.jp: 私は……私はおかしくない！^00私も生きている！　私もちゃんと、人間なんだ！
records.en_original: There's nothing wrong with me!^00I'm alive! I'm real, living human being!
records.en: There's nothing wrong with me!^00I'm alive! I'm real, living human being!

records.jp: あはは、あははははははははははははは！！！！
records.en_original: Ahaha! Hahahahahahahaha!
records.en: Ahaha! Hahahahahahahaha!

records.jp: せっかくの休みなんだから、^00たまにはどこか遊びに行ったら？
records.en_original: It's your summer break—don't you think you should go out and do something?
records.en: It's your summer break—don't you think you should go out and do something?

records.jp: まったく、^00ごろごろしてばっかりだと太るわよ
records.en_original: Seriously, you can't keep lazing around home at every day!
records.en: Seriously, you can't keep lazing around home at every day!

records.jp: …………いいなぁ
records.en_original: ...I wish that were me.
records.en: ...I wish that were me.

records.jp: （ふと、そんな言葉が口をついて出て）
records.en_original: (Oops, did I say that out loud?)
records.en: (Oops, did I say that out loud?)

records.jp: （もし私に、何か誇れるものが一つあれば。^00それさえあれば、私だって――）
records.en_original: (I wish I had something that I could be proud of. ^00If I had that, just one thing, I—)
records.en: (I wish I had something that I could be proud of. ^00If I had that, just one thing, I—)

records.jp: 帰るの、諦めちゃうの？
records.en_original: Are you giving up on that?
records.en: Are you giving up on that?

records.jp: それなら、調べてみる価値はありそうじゃない？
records.en_original: If that's the case, it's certainly worth looking into.
records.en: If that's the case, it's certainly worth looking into.

records.jp: わたしたちと一緒に来てほしいのです！
records.en_original: We'd like you to come with us!
records.en: We'd like you to come with us!

records.jp: うん
records.en_original: It's like my own secret hideout.
records.en: It's like my own secret hideout.

records.jp: はい。すごく難しい状況ですけど……^00こうしてまた会って話せて、本当に良かったです
records.en_original: Yes, these are not the best of circumstances, ^00but I'm glad that we could all meet again and talk like this.
records.en: Yes, these are not the best of circumstances, ^00but I'm glad that we could all meet again and talk like this.

records.jp: とりあえず今日は休もう！　いろいろあって、疲れた！
records.en_original: Let's call it a day for today! I'm tired!
records.en: Let's call it a day for today! I'm tired!

records.jp: おかえり、ユズ。ライム
records.en_original: Welcome back, Yuzu. Lime.
records.en: Welcome back, Yuzu. Lime.

records.jp: ……ただいま、ヒナちゃん！
records.en_original: Thank you, Hina!
records.en: Thank you, Hina-chan!

records.jp: うまれかわれ
records.en_original: Be Reborn
records.en: Be Reborn

records.jp: おばあちゃんは、私がここに来ると嬉しいの？
records.en_original: Does it make you happy when I come here?
records.en: Grandma, does it make you happy when I come here?

records.jp: おばあちゃんは、^00いつでも詩のことを想ってるからね……
records.en_original: I always think about you, Uta.
records.en: Grandma is always thinking of you, Uta...

records.jp: どう思った……？　うーん……
records.en_original: How do I feel...? Um....
records.en: How do I feel...? Um....

records.jp: ふふ、詩は不思議な子だねえ
records.en_original: Haha, you're an interesting one, Uta.
records.en: Haha, you're an interesting one, Uta.

records.jp: 詩、ひまわりが好きなのかい？
records.en_original: Do you like sunflowers, Uta?
records.en: Do you like sunflowers, Uta?

records.jp: なんでおばあちゃんが喜ぶの？
records.en_original: Why does that make you happy?
records.en: Why does that make Grandma happy?

records.jp: ……好きって、言ってない……
records.en_original: I didn't say I liked them...
records.en: I didn't say I liked them...

records.jp: ねえ詩。今年はおばあちゃんの家行かないの？
records.en_original: Hey, Uta? How about going to visit Grandma this year?
records.en: Hey, Uta. Aren't you going to Grandma's house this year?

records.jp: 知らない。私には関係ないことだから
records.en_original: Whatever.^00That has nothing to do with me.
records.en: Whatever.^00That has nothing to do with me.

records.jp: なんで私が行かなきゃいけないの？
records.en_original: Why do I have to go?
records.en: Why do I have to go?

records.jp: そんなの分からないって、言ってんのよ
records.en_original: I told you, I don't care.
records.en: I told you, I don't care.

records.jp: 駒川。お前、勉強は普通にできるのに^00なんで国語だけはダメなんだ？
records.en_original: Uta, you're good at all your other classes. Why is it just Japanese that's so hard for you?
records.en: Uta, you're good at all your other classes. Why is it just Japanese that's so hard for you?

records.jp: みんなが当たり前のようにしている、^00人の気持ちを考えることが、私にはできない
records.en_original: It might be natural for everyone else, but I've never been able to think about how people feel.
records.en: It might be natural for everyone else, but I've never been able to think about how people feel.

records.jp: ……私って、変かな？
records.en_original: ...Am I weird?
records.en: ...Am I weird?

records.jp: 駒川さんって趣味とか、何かあるの？
records.en_original: Uta, do you have any hobbies?
records.en: Komagawa-san, do you have any hobbies?

records.jp: 何考えてるのかも、^00私たちのことをどう見てるのかも分からないから……
records.en_original: We never really know what you're thinking, or what you think of us, so...
records.en: We never really know what you're thinking, or what you think of us, so...

records.jp: （亡霊の声が聞こえる。^00なくなった祖母の、亡霊の声が）
records.en_original: (I hear a voice... The voice of my dead grandma.)
records.en: (I hear a voice... The voice of my dead grandma.)

records.jp: （消えてしまえ）
records.en_original: (Go away.)
records.en: (Go away.)

records.jp: ……大っ嫌い
records.en_original: ...I hate them.
records.en: ...I hate them.

records.jp: ううん。嫌いじゃないよ。でも、好きでもない
records.en_original: No. I don't hate you. But, I don't really like you either.
records.en: No. I don't hate you. But, I don't really like you either.

records.jp: じゃあ、詩に好かれるように、^00おばあちゃん頑張らないとね
records.en_original: Well then Grandma will^00just have to grow some.
records.en: Then Grandma will have to work hard so you'll like her.

records.jp: To Be Continued...
records.en_original: To Be Continued…
records.en: To Be Continued…

records.jp: ちょっ！？　何言ってるんだよ！！^00僕だよ、僕、忘れちゃったの！？
records.en_original: Hey! What are you talking about?!^00It's me! Did you already forget me!?
records.en: Hey! What are you talking about?!^00It's me! Did you already forget me!?

records.jp: はじめまして、パトリツィア・アーベルハイムです。^00パティと呼んでもらえれば結構です
records.en_original: My name is Patricia Abelheim, but you can call me Patty.^00I'm very pleased to meet you.
records.en: My name is Patricia Abelheim, but you can call me Patty.^00I'm very pleased to meet you.

records.jp: よーし、それじゃあ、出発しよう！
records.en_original: Okay, are we all done? Then let's go!
records.en: Okay, are we all done? Then let's go!

records.jp: お前たちは……大切な仲間だ。^00一度断っておいて、勝手だけどな
records.en_original: I mean...you're my friends, right? Though it might be kind of selfish of me,^00coming after I turned you down before...
records.en: I mean...you're my friends, right? Though it might be kind of selfish of me,^00coming after I turned you down before...

records.jp: ライザ。^00お前の力、オレに貸してもらえないか？
records.en_original: Ryza, would you be willing to lend me a hand?
records.en: Ryza, would you be willing to lend me a hand?

records.jp: えっ！？　あたし？
records.en_original: Huh? M-Me?
records.en: Huh? M-Me?

records.jp: 不足してるものを教えてよ。^00あたしがその分、用意するからさ
records.en_original: Just tell me what you need, I'm sure I can get it for you.
records.en: Just tell me what you need, I'm sure I can get it for you.

records.jp: 友達なんだから遠慮はなしだよ
records.en_original: Hey, what are friends for?
records.en: Hey, what are friends for?

records.jp: いえ、ダメではありませんが……、^00実はこの扉、開かないんです
records.en_original: O-Of course I wouldn't stand in your way, Miss Patricia...^00But I can't open this gate.
records.en: O-Of course I wouldn't stand in your way, Miss Patricia...^00But I can't open this gate.

records.jp: これは、何かのシーンを描いてるのかな？^00僕らの知らない神話の一部とか
records.en_original: This scene must have some meaning...^00Maybe it's part of some legend we just don't know about.
records.en: This scene must have some meaning...^00Maybe it's part of some legend we just don't know about.

records.jp: それに、みんながいてくれたら、^00なんとかなる気がするんだ
records.en_original: As long as we have each other, we'll all be okay.
records.en: As long as we have each other, we'll all be okay.

records.jp: みんなの気持ちに応えるためにも、頑張らないとね
records.en_original: So we have to do our best to match their feelings, okay?
records.en: So we have to do our best to match their feelings, okay?

records.jp: 間違いないわ。^00他の遺跡と同じ魔力が森全体に通ってる
records.en_original: There's no mistaking it—this forest is filled with mana,^00just like all the other ruins.
records.en: There's no mistaking it—this forest is filled with mana,^00just like all the other ruins.

records.jp: ああ、強い魔物の気配をビリビリ感じるぜ
records.en_original: That's true. I can sense the presence of extremely powerful monsters...
records.en: That's true. I can sense the presence of extremely powerful monsters...

records.jp: ど、毒の霧！？^00どどど、どうしよう、早く逃げないと……！！
records.en_original: P-Poisonous fog!? Wh-What are we going to do!? We need to get out of here!
records.en: P-Poisonous fog!? Wh-What are we going to do!? We need to get out of here!

records.jp: そうみたいね。^00やっと、見つけた……
records.en_original: Looks that way. So we finally found it...
records.en: Looks that way. So we finally found it...

records.jp: 昔からそうなんだよね、はは……。^00夢中になったら一直線！　みたいな感じで
records.en_original: Yeah, I've always been like that. Hehe...^00Once I get into something, I stay focused like an arrow!
records.en: Yeah, I've always been like that. Hehe...^00Once I get into something, I stay focused like an arrow!

records.jp: レントやタオ、クラウディアは苦労したでしょうね……
records.en_original: You must have caused lots of trouble for your friends growing up...
records.en: You must have caused lots of trouble for your friends growing up...
